How to earn points

You earn shop points in two ways. Your in-game score is separate from your shop points.

1. Play-time points

Earn 1 point for every 10 seconds of active play. That’s up to 6 points per minute.

The earning timer starts when you start moving in Snake, launch the ball, use the Space Invaders or Block Stack controls, or make progress in a game. Progress includes clearing an alien, placing a block, eating a dot, or making a valid move. If you make no progress for 12 seconds, the earning timer stops until you make progress again. Menus, paused games, and waiting to launch the ball never count.

2. Progress bonuses

The actions below each build up 1 extra point:

GameActions for 1 bonus point
Space InvadersDestroy 5 aliens.
Block StackPlace 4 pieces, clear 2 lines, or combine both. For example, 2 pieces + 1 line also counts.
Maze MuncherEat 25 dots or power pellets.
2048Make 4 moves that actually change the board.
SnakeEat 2 foods.
Block BreakerHit bricks 5 times. A hit counts even if the brick takes another hit to break.

A bonus needs both the actions and the play time. Every 10 seconds of active play also allows 1 bonus point to be paid out. Doing lots of actions quickly won’t pay all the bonuses at once: up to 2 points’ worth of progress can wait for enough play time. If you have the play time first, up to 2 bonus points can wait for enough actions.

Watch the game’s point display: it shows time points and bonus points separately. When a bonus is ready but needs more play time, it shows how many active seconds remain. Eating 2 foods earns 1 bonus; eating 4 earns 2, as the play-time allowance becomes available.

An example

Play actively for 30 seconds and destroy 10 aliens. You earn 3 play-time points + 2 bonus points = 5 shop points. With 15 aliens in those same 30 seconds, you could earn 6 points instead.

The long-run maximum is 12 points per active minute: 6 from time and 6 from progress. Your total will be lower if you make less progress or spend time paused or idle.

What gets saved?

Whole points go straight into your balance as you earn them. You don’t need to finish a game. Points already earned, purchases, and equipped cosmetics are saved in this browser.

Unpaid progress toward a bonus resets when you start a new run. Partial play time carries between runs during this visit, but it isn’t saved after a reload. Clearing browser data removes your saved balance and purchases.
